title: M9 Base Medium for Bee Gut Bacteria
author: Philipp Engel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kdqcs5w

steps.title: Prepare HMB Modified Metals (Component 1)
steps.instruction: Prepare a modified metals stock solution by dissolving specific salts in ddH2O at pH=2 and mixing them.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1.095g ZnSO4 x 7H2O in 5ml ddH2O at pH=2
Dissolve 0.914g FeSO4 x 7H2O in 5ml ddH2O at pH=2
Dissolve 0.154g MnSO4 x H2O in 5ml ddH2O at pH=2
Dissolve 0.392g CuSO4 x 5H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2
Dissolve 0.248g Co(NO3)2 x 6H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2
Dissolve 0.177g Na2B4O7 x 10H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2
Mix the full volumes of the first three solutions (Zn, Fe, Mn) and add 10ml each of the CuSO4, Co(NO3)2, and Na2B4O7 solutions
Adjust final volume to 100ml
Sterile-filter using a 0.22 um filter
Store at 4°C, protected from light

steps.title: Prepare Additional Salt Components (2-5)
steps.instruction: Prepare four separate salt stock solutions, each dissolved in ddH2O at pH=2 and sterile-filtered.

substeps.instruction: Component 2: Dissolve 1.72g MgSO4 x 7H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2, sterile-filter with 0.22 um filter
Component 3: Dissolve 3.33g CaCl2 x 2H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2, sterile-filter with 0.22 um filter
Component 4: Dissolve 0.99g FeSO4 x 7H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2, sterile-filter with 0.22 um filter
Component 5: Dissolve 0.974g (NH4)6Mo7O24 x 4H2O in 100ml ddH2O at pH=2, sterile-filter with 0.22 um filter
Store all at RT, protected from light

steps.title: Prepare Vitamin 10x Stock (Component 6)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10x vitamin stock solution by mixing individual vitamin solutions and ddH2O.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1.5g L-aspartate potassium in 20ml ddH2O
Dissolve 0.2g Calcium pantothenate in 10ml ddH2O
Dissolve 0.01g Thiamine-HCl in 10ml ddH2O
Dissolve 0.01g biotin in 10ml ddH2O
Mix 59ml ddH2O, 20ml of the L-aspartate potassium solution, 10ml of the Calcium pantothenate solution, 10ml of the Thiamine-HCl solution, and 1ml of the biotin solution
Sterile-filter the final 100ml solution
Store at 4°C, protected from light (stable for at least 6 months)

steps.title: Prepare Casamino Acids 10x Stock (Component 7)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10x stock solution of casamino acids.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 200g casamino acids (BD) in 1000ml ddH2O
Autoclave the solution
Store at RT

steps.title: Prepare M9 10x Stock (Component 8)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10x stock solution of M9 salts.

substeps.instruction: Mix 60g Na2HPO4, 30g KH2PO4, 5g NaCl, and 10g NH4Cl
Add water to reach a final volume of 1L
Autoclave the solution
Store at RT

steps.title: Prepare 500ml M9 Base Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the final M9 base medium freshly on the day of use by mixing the components and ddH2O.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following: 500 μl Component 1, 8390 μl Component 2, 1000 μl Component 3, 100 μl Component 4, 10 μl Component 5, 50ml Component 6 (10x Vitamin stock), 50ml Component 7 (10x Casamino acids stock), 50ml Component 8 (10x M9 stock), and 340 ml ddH2O
